title: Foundation of German Business (sdw): Academic study sponsorship
summary: Financial support and seminars for undergraduate and graduate students at German higher education institutions, requiring intermediate German proficiency and BAföG eligibility.

degree_levels.notes: Students pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, Diplom, Magister or state examination degree can apply.

subject_areas.notes: No specific subject restrictions are mentioned in the text.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised higher education institutions in Germany.

nationality.notes: Any (future) undergraduate or graduate student who are eligible for funding under §8, 1-3 BAföG may apply. Country dropdown lists available options on the page.

residence.notes: Not explicitly restricted to in_germany or outside_germany, though study takes place in Germany or border countries under specific conditions.

mandatory.text: At least intermediate-level command of German (C1 or DSH 2)

Studying at state or state-recognised higher education institutions in Germany (or a complete course of study abroad in a country close to the border with active participation in an sdw regional group)

funding.description: All scholarship holders receive a not means-tested study allowance of 300 EUR per month. Maximum scholarship for living support is 855 EUR per month, depending on family financial situation. Contributions to health- and long-term care insurance: 137 EUR per month where applicable. Childcare allowance: 160 EUR per month and child where applicable. Stays abroad are also funded.
funding.duration: Until the end of the standard period of study

application_rounds.notes: Current information on the application period can be found on the external sdw website.

steps.text: Submit your application via the application portal first.

sources.title: Foundation of German Business (sdw): Academic study sponsorship - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme funds undergraduate and graduate students pursuing a degree at state or state-recognised higher education institutions in Germany.
